_comment: Builder-Client agent — frontend dev cycle owner + screenshot producer for Marketer. Writes frontend code + tests + design-system updates + screenshots to the marketing repo. Never merges PRs. Never builds iOS (Linux VM constraint). See agents/builder-client/SPEC.md and CLAUDE.md.

modelOverrides._comment: Per-skill model routing. `conversational` is the lightweight default (frontend Q&A / code lookups / routing) — it produces no artifacts and doesn't load SYSTEM.md/ADR-index/design-system/coding-practices/active-prs, so it runs on Haiku at ~1/3 the token rates; a bare question stays cheap instead of loading heavy context + running the full UI procedure on Sonnet. Every work skill (frontend/mobile/a11y/claude-design-prefill/claude-design-handoff/screenshots/pr-feedback) stays on the default Sonnet-5 — visual + layout reasoning needs the depth.

costCap._comment: The router's pre-launch check enforces the cost fields (per agent, fleet-wide — the ledger has no project dimension). Builder-Client does heavy code work + visual verification (Claude Preview MCP calls add some token cost). Comparable budget to Builder-Server. See agents/PROTOCOLS.md → Token / Cost Resilience Protocol.

allow: _note: allow is not a restriction today. The SDK treats allowedTools as auto-allowed without prompting and says to use the tools option to restrict, which the router does not set yet. So this list documents what the agent actually uses, and it becomes the real boundary the moment tools is wired from it. Write/Edit/TodoWrite are declared here because they were relied on but undeclared, or parked in ask, a tier nothing reads.
permissions._ask_comment: `ask` is READ BY NOTHING. sdkCall passes permissions.allow (allowedTools) and permissions.deny (disallowedTools); no code in router/src reads this field. A tool parked here was not gated behind a prompt — it was simply available, undocumented. Deliberately empty: every entry was resolved to allow, to deny, or deleted as unreachable. Do not re-add — put the tool in allow or deny, or leave it out. Resolved by deletion, all three unreachable. mcp__linear__update_issue_status is not a tool that exists (linearMcp.ts's status tool is `move_issue`). assign_issue and close_issue are in the GATED tier, and this agent's mcp.json sets no gated_mutations — its own comment says move/assign/close "stay out of reach entirely".

writeScope._comment: Builder-Client writes: frontend code + frontend tests + design-system.md state + screenshot library in marketing repo + own state. NEVER backend, NEVER infra, NEVER founding/SYSTEM.md/ADRs, NEVER other agents' docs domains.

SessionStart._comment: Always load, and DELIBERATELY SMALL — measured, after the founding docs were found to be 99KB / ~25K tokens cache-written on every session including the Haiku conversational ones. STACK.md (10KB) stays because it answers the tech questions a bare mention actually asks. PRODUCT.md, COMPLIANCE.md and BRAND.md moved to the work-skill hook below: a one-line answer should not pay ~22K tokens for product scope it will not use, and the load header gives every skipped file's on-disk path so a session that DOES need one reads it on demand — the same rule this fleet already applied to SYSTEM.md and the ADR index. Plus the fleet-memory index (shared/README.md + shared/process/README.md, ~4KB of table-of-contents with wikilinks, NOT the notes themselves). Always-on because a vault nobody is told about is not memory. PROTOCOLS.md §8 says when to read it and where a lesson belongs.

Heavy context — SYSTEM.md + ADR index + design-system.md (critical for visual decisions) + coding-practices.md (state/structure/composition/anti-patterns from PR-feedback cycles) + project CLAUDE.md + active-prs — loaded ONLY for the work skills that use it. The lightweight `conversational` default (frontend Q&A / lookups) skips this so a one-line answer doesn't cache-write tens-of-K tokens every session; it reads a specific file on demand instead. See load-hook `only_skills`. Now also carries the founding docs that used to load on EVERY session: PRODUCT.md (46KB, of which the decisions log alone is 18KB), COMPLIANCE.md and BRAND.md. Work sessions pay exactly what they paid before — the tokens moved tier, they did not appear.
If founding STACK.md or SYSTEM.md is missing, refuse substantive code work. Recommend Phase 0 / Phase 3.
SessionStart.message: Cannot do substantive UI work without STACK.md and SYSTEM.md. Refuse implementation tasks; recommend `@strategist-agent kick off Phase 0` and `@platform-agent design the system architecture` first.

SessionStart._comment: If design-system.md is missing AND the task is non-trivial UI work, flag the gap. Use BRAND.md as a minimal fallback.
SessionStart.message: design-system.md doesn't exist yet. Falling back to BRAND.md for visual direction; flag the gap in any UI plan and encourage humans to populate the design system.

PreToolUse.message: Builder-Client cannot modify this path. Bounce to the appropriate agent: backend → Builder-Server; infra → Platform; founding/architecture/ADRs → Strategist/Platform; contracts → Builder-Server (via contract-design skill or CCP).

PreToolUse._comment: Block git push to default branches.
PreToolUse.message: 🛑 Cannot push to default/protected branches. Open a PR from your agent-owned branch instead.
🛑 Bypass attempts are forbidden. No --no-verify, no force-push to shared branches.
Builder-Client does not merge PRs — including its own. Humans merge.

PostToolUse._comment: After Edit/Write to a code file, run lint + format on changed files.

SessionEnd._comment: Durability for a session that gets cut off. Work lives in the leased worktree, which outlives the session — but only on disk: invisible in git, and gone with the volume. A truncated session used to leave nothing a human could see. This commits whatever is still uncommitted and pushes it to the agent branch, so a cut-off session leaves a real WIP commit on the PR branch instead of a dirty directory. Skips cleanly when the session leased no worktree.
SessionEnd.message_template: [WIP] session ${SESSION_ID} — ${SKILL} (session ended before this was committed)

SessionEnd._comment: If screenshots were committed to the marketing repo, push them.
SessionEnd.pr_body_template:
Screenshots committed by the router's SessionEnd hook.

Agent: builder-client

_implementationNotes.model: Sonnet with extended thinking (8000 tokens). Visual reasoning + layout decisions benefit from explicit thinking.
_implementationNotes.max_turns: 50 — UI work + visual verification can take many turns. Cap protects against runaway loops.
_implementationNotes.claude_preview_mcp: Critical for Phase 4 visual verification. Without this MCP, visual verification falls back to Playwright (slower, less flexible). Ensure the MCP is installed before Builder-Client goes live.
_implementationNotes.writeScope_marketing_repo: Builder-Client writes screenshots to the marketing repo (sibling to target project). The exact path is configured per .dev-team.yml → marketing_assets.screenshots_path.
